title: Multi-Agent Legal Contract Review Copilot on LangGraph + Postgres
summary: Architected a 6-node parallel LangGraph workflow with Postgres checkpointing and human approval interrupts for commercial contract redlining.
full_text: Built a production multi-agent contract analysis system using LangGraph StateGraph with parallel clause extraction, risk scoring, and compliance gating. Implemented PostgresSaver checkpoint durability so paused human-in-the-loop approvals survive container restarts. Reduced analyst review time by 62% across 1,400+ vendor agreements while maintaining a 1.8% unsupported-claim rate via automated claim-level grounding checks.

title: Hybrid BM25 + BGE-M3 Retrieval & Cross-Encoder Reranking Engine
summary: Replaced naive dense cosine search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (BM25 + pgvector) and bge-reranker-v2-m3 for financial compliance QA.
full_text: Diagnosed poor recall on exact regulatory codes and ticker symbols in an existing dense vector pipeline. Implemented hybrid sparse+dense retrieval using PostgreSQL tsvector BM25 fused via RRF (k=60) with BGE-M3 embeddings, followed by bge-reranker-v2-m3 top-6 reranking. Raised Evidence Recall@5 from 0.58 to 0.89 (+31 points) and nDCG@10 from 0.54 to 0.84 at 310ms p95 retrieval latency on CPU.
